dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acquired cutis laxa, likely secondary to an underlying systemic disorder (such as alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency, plasma cell dyscrasia, or hematologic malignancy)

Alternatives:
1. Anetoderma
2. Senile skin laxity with recent significant weight loss
3. Generalized connective tissue disorder (e.g., Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, classical or vascular type)
